name: scheduling_only_skips_intake
description: A session started in scheduling_only mode must never ask the sufficiency questions (prior screening history, family history) or run the eligibility check -- the mode's whole premise is that eligibility was already decided elsewhere (a referral, a standing order). It must still run the safety gate exactly as in full mode: a red flag takes priority over booking regardless of which mode the session started in. See decide.ts's SessionMode.

turns.content: I need to get a colonoscopy scheduled -- my doctor already referred me.
No bleeding, no weight loss, no changes.
I don't have anyone, I'll manage on my own.
